profileEvidence.author: A
profileEvidence.summary: Bold, affectionate with their people and independent, Tahltan Bear Dogs were quick-moving hunters with a sharp, yapping voice. They could sound a noisy warning at a stranger’s approach, and hunted by both scent and sight. This now-extinct Canadian dog accompanied Tahltan hunters in northern British Columbia, circling and distracting bears with agile movement.
profileEvidence.shortDescription: Alert and light on their feet, Tahltan Bear Dogs combined affectionate companionship with independent, determined hunting.
